literal_meaning: ছয় বুড়ি, ছয় গণ্ডা (six old women, six cheeks)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে ছবুড়ি ছগণ্ডা লোক জড়ো হয়েছে।
সেই দিনে ছবুড়ি ছগণ্ডা অতিথি এসেছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: There were choburi chogonda people gathered at the market.
On that day, a choburi chogonda number of guests arrived.
